verdict.rationale: Data-use and AI-training opt-out policies are a fair privacy question for any SaaS that processes merchant and customer data, including a payments platform like Mollie, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack covers an AI-training opt-out, a data-usage policy, or model-training controls. The MCP server, test-mode isolation and auth scopes are about other things and do not address this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
